seoTitle: Dotto | Homes Shaped by Art, Colour & Material
seoDescription: Dotto is a London interior design studio blending art, craftsmanship and emotion to create layered, timeless spaces.

paragraphs.text: Dotto was founded in 2014 by Sophie Dotto, who is half South African, half English and grew up between Stellenbosch, Cape Town and the UK before broadening her architectural and design sensibility through a BA in History of Art at Leeds University, and going on to study Interior Design at Parsons, The New School for Design in Manhattan, New York.

Sophie is also the co-founder of United Design, a charitable initiative which launched in July 2020 with a mission to address the lack of diversity in interior design, and in 2021 launched the retail offshoot Sister by Dotto, which opened its first bricks and mortar home at The Blewcoat School in St James’s Park in 2022.

Today, the studio is led by Sophie alongside Partners Fiona Blanchot and Nicola Koller, ensuring the studio’s vision is carried across all work with the same depth of care and creative rigour. Together, the team creates spaces with a unique identity, looking to bring authenticity to each project, unswayed by the passing dictates of fashion.

Our diverse portfolio spans a Grade II listed Edwardian Arts & Crafts home fronting Hyde Park, a six-storey Georgian villa in Holland Park, a contemporary family home in Brighton, a luxury pied-à-terre in Mayfair, a jewel box apartment in Belgravia, a brownstone in New York, a family home in Hong Kong and boutique hotels in South Africa, Mallorca and London.
In 2026, Dotto opened an office in Cape Town, deepening the studio’s connection to South Africa.

A stone's throw from St James's Park, nestled in a rare skyscraper-less clearing on Caxton Street, sits the Grade I listed Blewcoat School, which is home to Dotto and our shoppable world, Sister. Blewcoat is a commanding presence in the area, having stood there since 1709, when it was built as a school for the underprivileged – a Bluecoat School. In 1899, the Blewcoat charity relocates to a purpose-built space, leaving the building as an elementary school. The name, however, remains through the decades. In 1954, the building is purchased by the National Trust to house a gift shop, which remains operational until 2013, when bridal wear designer Ian Stewart reimagines it into his showroom.

As Dotto becomes the next custodian of this magical and historic site, we aim to create a sense of home for all who visit. From clients to Sister shoppers and brand partners, Dotto’s tenure at Blewcoat transforms it into a go-to destination that connects with and grows our wonderful community.

Sophie Dotto is half South African, half English and grew up between Stellenbosch (Cape Town) and the UK before broadening her architectural and design sensibility through a BA in History of Art at Leeds University, going on to study Interior Design at Parsons, The New School for Design in Manhattan, New York.

Sophie founded her interior design and creative direction practice, Dotto Ltd, in 2014 at the age of 25, and is also the co-founder of United Design, a new charitable initiative which launched in July 2020, with a mission to address the lack of diversity in interior design. In 2021, Sophie also launched her retail offshoot, Sister by Dotto, which opened its first bricks and mortar home at the Blewcoat School in St James’s Park in 2022.

paragraphs.text: Fiona began her career after earning a BA Hons in Interior Architecture, setting the foundation for a diverse and accomplished journey in design. Over the past seventeen years, she has worked on a wide array of high-profile projects, spanning industries such as luxury residential, retail, and hospitality.

For the last decade, Fiona has been a key figure at Dotto, collaborating closely with founder Sophie Dotto to help grow the studio into an established and respected name in the industry. Her contributions have been instrumental in expanding the business while maintaining the studio's reputation for delivering exceptional designs.

In addition to her role in shaping the wider business strategy, Fiona has taken on the role of Project Lead for numerous high-profile schemes. She thrives on the balance between creativity and technical precision, combining both to deliver cohesive and innovative designs. Her approach is holistic, ensuring that each project reflects both aesthetic beauty and functional excellence.

Fiona's passion lies in how spaces are experienced by their inhabitants. She focuses on meticulous space planning, the use of natural materials, and the final touches - furniture and art - to create environments that not only look beautiful but feel intuitive and welcoming. This attention to detail has made her a leader in interior architecture, committed to enhancing the way people live, work, and interact with their surroundings.

Nicola is a highly experienced architect and leader with over 20 years of expertise in luxury retail, residential, and commercial projects. With a BA (Hons) in Architecture from Oxford Brookes University and an MA in Architecture from the Royal College of Art (RCA), Nicola has cultivated a deep understanding of design and its impact on culture, society, and business.

For 13 years, Nicola collaborated with Paul Smith, overseeing the design and delivery of over 800 projects worldwide, enhancing the brand's global footprint through innovative retail experiences. Their extensive experience in high-end retail reflects a strong proficiency in delivering creative, functional, and aesthetically compelling spaces.

With strong leadership, communication, research, and problem-solving skills, Nicola excels in guiding multidisciplinary teams and driving projects to successful outcomes. Their dedication to excellence in design education and practice is reflected in their role at the RCA, the world’s leading postgraduate art and design institution, which has been ranked number one internationally for eight consecutive years.
Nicola’s key skills include establishing environments for creative growth, active listening and a strong understanding of global trends and policy developments.

leftParagraphs.text: We are a dynamic group of experienced designers, specialising in both residential and commercial interior design, as well as creative direction, across the UK, Europe, and beyond. Our team brings together a wealth of expertise, creativity, and a deep understanding of design, which allows us to work seamlessly across different styles, cultures, and client needs.

At the core of our work is a commitment to a positive, professional, and personal approach. We believe in fostering strong, transparent relationships with our clients, ensuring that every project is tailored to their unique vision and functional requirements. Whether we're working on a bespoke residential project or a large-scale commercial space, we approach each task with the same level of care and dedication, making the process as enjoyable and smooth as the outcome is beautiful and practical.

We take pride in our efficiency and collaborative spirit, working closely with our clients, architects, and contractors to deliver high-quality results within set timeframes and budgets. Integrity and authenticity are at the heart of everything we do - we believe that interior spaces should reflect the true essence of those who inhabit them. By combining our technical expertise with a soulful, thoughtful design process, we strive to create environments that not only look stunning but also feel meaningful and enriching for those who use them.

paragraphs.text: United in Design is a charitable organisation founded by Sophie Dotto and Alexandria Dauley to address the lack of diversity in the UK Interior Design industry.

Through partnerships with established educational programmes, industry professionals and sponsors, the intention is to provide a clear road map for increased diversity in all sectors of the industry design studios, makers, suppliers to individuals and magazines.
In 2021 the charity was honoured with House & Garden’s ‘Special Contribution to the Design Industry’ award and Homes & Gardens ‘Contribution to Design’ award.
Find out more at  www.unitedindesign.com  or contact us on hello@unitedindesign.com
